implementation_role: candidate derivation; implementer did not review this artifact
solution_concept: perfect Bayesian equilibrium under the frozen Gate 0 consequential-equality response convention

discount_accounting.active_H_failure: beta times the literal selected C2-majority-active-H payoff, exactly once
discount_accounting.H_no_weak_failure: H receives o_theta immediately without beta; each weak state receives beta times the literal selected C2-majority-weak-only payoff, exactly once
discount_accounting.export: all payoffs in this interface are already in Round-1 units; descendants do not discount them again

state_key: (M,round=1,H=active,full h1,mu(h1)) before the uniform weak-proposer recognition draw

belief_layers.on_support_proposal: rho(s)=mu because the weak proposer has no private information and recognition is type-independent
belief_layers.globally_off_path_proposal: rho(s) is an explicit assessment component in [0,1]
belief_layers.voter_distribution: weak voters and C2 posterior maps use rho(s)
belief_layers.deviation_distribution: the proposer evaluates every proposal deviation under true mu, never under rho(s)
belief_layers.positive_probability_h2: Bayes uses rho(s), the type-contingent H action, and the complete local strategy; the weak vector has no type likelihood conditional on s
belief_layers.zero_probability_h2: an explicit off-path posterior is retained, including histories reached only after a pure-action deviation
belief_layers.full_history: equal posteriors do not merge histories because continuation selections and completion maps may differ

continuation_selection_maps.active_H: for every H-yes plus weak-failure full h2, kappa_A(h2) is one literal complete element of frozen C2_M_active(h2)
continuation_selection_maps.weak_only: for every H-no plus weak-failure full h2, kappa_O(h2) is one literal complete element of frozen C2_M_WO(h2)
continuation_selection_maps.timing: both maps are assessment components fixed before the current ballot, not ex-post voter choices
continuation_selection_maps.public_measurability: kappa_A and kappa_O are functions only of the complete public h2; they cannot condition directly on privately known theta
continuation_selection_maps.type_blind_selection: if one public h2 is compatible with both types, one selected C2 element governs both and supplies its internal type-conditional payoff and outcome coordinates; there is no kappa_theta
continuation_selection_maps.no_scalarization: retain strategies, beliefs, type and identity payoffs, recognition averaging, terminal signatures, gifts, and completion maps from each selected C2 element
continuation_selection_maps.distinct_histories: two histories reaching the same named C2 class may receive different admissible selections and are compared action by action

transition_and_payoff_map.outcome: weak-caused failure with H still active
transition_and_payoff_map.payoffs_R1: beta*C^A_{k,theta}(h2) for every player k, with beta applied once

transition_and_payoff_map.outcome: current weak-only passage after immediate H opt-out
immediate H opt-out followed by weak-only C2
transition_and_payoff_map.payoffs_R1: H:o_theta exactly once without beta; weak k:beta*C^O_k(h2) exactly once

fixed_proposal_fixed_point.weak_profile_probability: P_p(a)=product_j p_j^{a_j}(1-p_j)^{1-a_j}, with independent behavioral randomizations
fixed_proposal_fixed_point.H_relevance: one: yes versus no changes at least opt-out status for every weak vector, independently of whether the weak quota is met
fixed_proposal_fixed_point.H_response: h_theta=yes iff Delta_H(theta)>=0; otherwise no; equality yes and no H mixing

weak_H_yes_difference.z0_at_least_q_minus_1: 0 because both actions pass the same current proposal

weak_H_no_difference.z0_at_least_q: 0 because both actions pass the same current weak-only proposal

fixed_proposal_fixed_point.weak_expected_difference: D_j is the rho-weighted expectation of the applicable action-specific difference over theta, H action, and every a_-j
fixed_proposal_fixed_point.weak_relevance: R_j is the probability that the two complete Gate 0 outcome signatures differ after evaluating action-specific C2 selections; equal raw node labels do not establish irrelevance
fixed_proposal_fixed_point.weak_response: if R_j>0, p_j=1 when D_j>=0 and p_j=0 when D_j<0; if R_j=0, any p_j in [0,1] is an explicit completion
fixed_proposal_fixed_point.mixed_actions: a weak interior randomization can occur only as a zero-relevance completion
fixed_proposal_fixed_point.fixed_point_status: necessary and sufficient for ballot sequential rationality at fixed proposal, beliefs, posteriors, and continuation maps

type_and_identity_payoff_correspondence.type_conditional: for each theta integrate the complete PR04-PR07 payoff and outcome vector over all weak action vectors using P_p
type_and_identity_payoff_correspondence.proposal_mixture_type_payoff: U_k^{i,theta}(alpha_i)=integral U_k^theta(s,A_i(s)) d sigma_i(s) for every player identity k
type_and_identity_payoff_correspondence.H_and_named_weak: use the same true-mu joint distribution for G_H and every identity-specific G_j
type_and_identity_payoff_correspondence.retained_nonpayoff_coordinates: proposal, full ballot vector, posterior, PR branch, H inclusion, irreversible opt-out, y destination, payment vector, selected C2 assessment, and terminal/continuation signature

proposal_assessment.components: sigma_i; rho_i(s); type actions; independent weak probabilities and full-profile completions; posterior map; kappa_A and kappa_O at every failed h2; complete type, identity, payoff, belief, and outcome vectors
proposal_assessment.local_condition: the fixed-proposal fixed point holds at every feasible proposal, including globally off-path proposals
proposal_assessment.proposer_support: support is contained in the nonempty argmax_s G_i(s;mu), with every deviation integrated under true mu
proposal_assessment.tie_break: after proposer-payoff maximization retain only maximizers minimizing G_H(s;mu); if both payoffs tie and downstream objects differ, retain the correspondence
proposal_assessment.proposal_mixing: support elements have the same maximal proposer payoff and the same tie-minimal H payoff
proposal_assessment.nonattainment_warning: an arbitrary off-path belief/completion map can make the continuum-action objective discontinuous; the exact characterization requires an attained argmax and never substitutes a supremum
proposal_assessment.necessity_and_sufficiency: the listed local fixed points, Bayes consistency, literal C2 membership, attained proposer argmax, and primitive tie-break are necessary and sufficient for a recognized-proposer PBE

N_equals_3.weak_only_C2: unique pre-recognition payoff 1/2 for each weak identity
N_equals_3.weak_response: when rejection has positive ballot-belief probability, yes iff x_j>=beta/2; otherwise an explicit completion
N_equals_3.why_A_is_not_forced_at_o0_zero: y=0,x_j=b is separating, not both-reject; off-path rho=0 plus weak-no completion gives (1-mu)A+mu*b<=C
N_equals_3.necessity: C and D are unavoidable deviation lower bounds; A is additionally unavoidable only when o_0>0; every on-support both-reject, separating, or pooling proposal is bounded above by A, C, or D
N_equals_3.sufficiency_every_V_o0_zero: for every V in [L,U], use a y=0 separating threshold construction when V<=max{A,C}, or pooling y=o_1,x_j=0 in the only remaining case V=D>max{A,C}; assign rho=0 and weak no to every distinct off-path separating proposal
N_equals_3.existence: nonempty for every primitive vector and mu, and nonempty at every value in the stated projection
N_equals_3.H_tie_break_o0_positive: if D>max{A,C}, tie-minimal H payoff is o_1; otherwise it is o_bar=(1-mu)o_0+mu o_1; a tied pooling signature survives only if its H payoff also ties
N_equals_3.H_tie_break_o0_zero: for V<=max{A,C}, tie-minimal H payoff is mu*o_1 and separating y=0 signatures attain it; if D>max{A,C}, the projection is {D} and tie-minimal H payoff is o_1
N_equals_3.mixing: support may mix only among proposals separately attaining the same V and the same tie-minimal H payoff; unequal pure payoffs are never averaged into optimality
N_equals_3.counterexample: beta=.5,o_0=0,o_1=.8,mu=.9 gives [L,U]=[.325,.75]; y=0,x_j=0 with weak no implements .325, while y=0,x_j=.675 with weak yes implements the same value and may be mixed with it

all_N_at_least_4_value_one.construction: on path y=0,X=0 and all weak nonproposers yes; H yes exactly for types with o_theta=0
all_N_at_least_4_value_one.N_at_least_5_weak_condition: a unilateral weak no leaves current passage under either H action, so the ballot is a completion
all_N_at_least_4_value_one.N_equals_4_weak_condition: after H no, select the admissible zero-vector C2_M_WO at the toggled history; current zero and continuation zero imply relevant equality and hence yes
all_N_at_least_4_value_one.payoffs: proposer one in every type; H its type-specific outside payoff
all_N_at_least_4_value_one.existence: proves a PBE exists for every N>=4, beta, mu, and primitive vector

proposer_projection_zero_to_one.on_path_construction: y=0, gifts X=1-V, all weak yes implements arbitrary V in [0,1]
proposer_projection_zero_to_one.N_at_least_6_punishment: all weak no plus class-F active-H C2 and zero-vector weak-only C2 gives every proposal deviation zero
proposer_projection_zero_to_one.small_N_punishment: with o_0>0 and beta<1 choose active-H C2 type payoff o_theta; after all weak no both types strictly choose immediate opt-out, and zero-vector weak-only C2 gives deviations zero
proposer_projection_zero_to_one.outside_domain: the exact fixed-point correspondence applies; [0,1] is not asserted

o0_zero_active_H_pathology.contrast: when o_0>0 the same recognized Round-2 proposer projection is {1}
o0_zero_active_H_pathology.identity_lower_bound: under the public posterior, every weak identity j has E_nu[C^A_W,j(h2)]>=D_A(nu(h2))/m by uniform recognition and nonnegative payoffs
o0_zero_active_H_pathology.degenerate_collapse: D_A=0 only at nu=1 and o_1=1
o0_zero_active_H_pathology.on_path_low_revelation: if separating H=yes reveals type 0, nu(h2)=0, so every weak identity's active-H continuation is at least 1/m and enters R1 as beta/m once
o0_zero_active_H_pathology.H_low_type: when o_0=0, H type 0 compares immediate no payoff zero with a nonnegative H-yes active continuation and selects yes at equality
o0_zero_active_H_pathology.beta_one_boundary: at beta=1 and o_0>0, an outside-payoff active-H selection also makes H choose yes at equality after failure
o0_zero_active_H_pathology.implication: the zero-punishment construction for N in {4,5} is unavailable on these boundaries; history-specific C2 selections must remain literal

pre_recognition_interface.recognition: each weak identity i is recognized with probability 1/m independently of theta and public history
pre_recognition_interface.sigma_expectation: U_k^{i,theta}(alpha_i)=integral U_k^theta(s,A_i(s)) d sigma_i(s) for every player identity k before recognition averaging
pre_recognition_interface.type_by_identity_correspondence: C1_M,k^alpha(theta|h1)=(1/m)sum_i U_k^{i,theta}(alpha_i) for every H or named weak identity k and each theta
pre_recognition_interface.correspondence: C1_M(h1) is the set of full vectors and distributions generated by every admissible identity-indexed alpha=(alpha_1,...,alpha_m)
pre_recognition_interface.outcome_distribution: apply the same sigma_i expectation and uniform 1/m recognition average to each type-conditional PR04-PR07, inclusion, opt-out, payment, full-history, and terminal/continuation-signature distribution
pre_recognition_interface.retained_coordinates: type-conditional H and every named weak payoff, player identities, proposal mixing, rho maps, full ballot vectors, public-measurable type-blind action-specific C2 selections, posteriors, PR04-PR07 probabilities, inclusion, opt-out, payments, and terminal/continuation signatures
pre_recognition_interface.history_index: full h1 is retained separately from mu
pre_recognition_interface.selection_status: set-valued; no selection beyond the primitive proposer/H tie-break

existence_and_multiplicity.global_existence: nonempty for every admissible primitive vector, beta, mu, and N>=3
existence_and_multiplicity.proof_partition: closed N=3 construction plus value-one construction for every N>=4
existence_and_multiplicity.multiplicity: generally a continuum of proposal-contingent beliefs, ballot completions, continuation selections, gifts, proposal mixtures, and type/identity outcome vectors
existence_and_multiplicity.exact_global_object: necessary-and-sufficient assessment fixed point; scalar projections are reported only for proved subclasses

boundary_cases: N=3: q=2; PR05 is empty and active-H C2 is unreachable; the proposer projection is {max(A,C,D)} when o_0>0 but [max(C,D),max(A,C,D)] when o_0=0
N=4: q=3; a weak deviation from the value-one all-yes construction can toggle H-no current passage versus C2_M_WO, so the zero-vector continuation is used literally
N=5: q=3; all-yes current passage remains secured after one weak deviation under either H action
N>=6: class-F C2_M_active and zero-vector C2_M_WO jointly permit selection-safe zero punishment and the [0,1] construction
beta=1: active-H continuation is still multiplied once; immediate opt-out is not discounted
mu=0 or mu=1: counterfactual type strategies and type payoff coordinates remain recorded; Bayes is imposed only at positive-probability histories
rho(s) may differ from mu only off path and never replaces mu in proposal optimality
H equality has positive relevance and prescribes yes; a weak equality with positive signature relevance prescribes yes; zero-relevance actions remain explicit completions
rejected_shortcuts: one continuation selection shared across full histories
global threshold y for H in R1
using rho instead of mu in proposer deviations
quotienting double-failure histories by raw successor label

verification.scope: dependency hashes and mutation; PR04-PR07 full-vector enumeration; action-specific C2 weak and H IC checks; rho-versus-mu separation; beta-once and immediate-optout accounting; exact N=3 singleton-or-interval projection with a non-tautological legacy-singleton mutation test and 48-plus primitive grid; constructive N and beta boundaries; active-H o_0=0 pathology; public-measurable type-blind continuations; sigma and full type-by-identity C1 export

invalidation: any change to the reviewed R2 batch, either frozen C2 interface, Gate 0 timing, ballot simultaneity, equality response, immediate H opt-out, discount convention, or proposal payment rule invalidates this interface and every descendant
artifact_hash_policy: the exact UTF-8 JSON bytes are hashed externally after serialization; no self-referential hash is embedded
